addon.name: Aperture
addon.provider-name: Aperture contributors; Estuary foundation by Team Kodi

extension.summary: A quiet scenic home for your games, films and music.
extension.description: Aperture is a controller-first Kodi 21 skin with an original misty-bridge home with horizontal glass navigation, six straightforward destinations and Kodi-native media browsing. The optional Aperture Album Shelf companion adds perspective album browsing. Install the companion Aperture Games add-on for local game browsing and in-Kodi libretro play. Complete settings, playback and dialogs use the attributed Estuary foundation. No external launcher or background service.
extension.license: GPL-2.0, GPL-2.0-or-later, CC-BY-SA-4.0; bundled font licenses in fonts/
extension.disclaimer: 1.0 release candidate for Kodi 21 Omega. Desktop runtime evidence is not Pi hardware acceptance. Original Home layout; remaining windows are based on Estuary. See UPSTREAM.md.
extension.news: 1.0.0~rc1: native Kodi release candidate; optional album shelf with current-playing/random initial focus and disc-ordered album playback.
